scripts.build:videos: bun --no-env-file scripts/tablecast-build.ts --film product && bun --no-env-file scripts/tablecast-build.ts --film technical
scripts.render: bun run render:product && bun run render:technical
scripts.render:product: bun run test:layout --project=product && hyperframes render dist/product --output output/tablecast-product-demo.mp4
scripts.render:technical: bun run test:layout --project=technical && hyperframes render dist/technical --output output/tablecast-technical-evaluation.mp4
scripts.check:video: bun run test:layout && hyperframes lint dist/product && hyperframes check dist/product --at-transitions && hyperframes lint dist/technical && hyperframes check dist/technical --at-transitions
